description: The type of sort option for a facet
name: FacetSortOptions

enum.name: COUNT
enum.description: Sort facet values by the number of results in each value, descending.

enum.name: MAX
enum.description: Sort facet values by the maximum value in each group, descending.

enum.name: SUM
enum.description: Sort facet values by the sum of values in each group, descending.
